TOPIC 1.8
Determining 
Limits Using the 
Squeeze Theorem

SUGGESTED SKILLS

Justification

3.C
Confirm whether hypotheses 
or conditions of a selected 
definition, theorem, or test have 
been satisfied.

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

LIM-1.E
Determine the limits of 
functions using equivalent 
expressions for the function 
or the squeeze theorem.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

LIM-1.E.2
The limit of a function may be found by using 
the squeeze theorem.

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

LIM-1
Reasoning with definitions, theorems, and properties can be used to justify claims 
about limits.
